source_audit.acceptance_effect: player_bomb clears miss_time and player_is_hit before the miss is registered

single_write_normal_bomb.conclusion: TH05's native keyboard refresh overwrote a one-shot key_det write before player_bomb observed it

refreshed_normal_bomb.conclusion: repeated submission establishes reliable action delivery

transactional_step.conclusion: learner and inference latency no longer advances the game without an agent action; the native guard can preempt a policy command inside an action window

fixed_policy_diagnostic.warning: The policy seed is fixed, but the native game RNG is not independently controlled; this is a causal event trace, not a paired statistical estimate.

conclusion: The low-latency online guard reliably converts all three available bombs into three cancelled collisions. A fourth fatal trajectory remains, so deathbomb safety fixes control latency but cannot substitute for a stronger movement policy. The next learner should use offline action-contrastive supervision or a stronger teacher and distill the result into a small online actor.
